\section*{Question 2}

The graphs of the polar curves \(r=3\) and \(r=3-2 \sin (2 \theta)\) are shown in the figure above for \(0 \leq \theta \leq \pi\).
\begin{itemize}
\item[(a)] Let \(R\) be the shaded region that is inside the graph of \(r=3\) and inside the graph of \(r=3-2 \sin (2 \theta)\). Find the area of \(R\).
\item[(b)] For the curve \(r=3-2 \sin (2 \theta)\), find the value of \(\frac{d x}{d \theta}\) at \(\theta=\frac{\pi}{6}\).
\item[(c)] The distance between the two curves changes for \(0<\theta<\frac{\pi}{2}\). Find the rate at which the distance between the two curves is changing with respect to \(\theta\) when \(\theta=\frac{\pi}{3}\).
\item[(d)] A particle is moving along the curve \(r=3-2 \sin (2 \theta)\) so that \(\frac{d \theta}{d t}=3\) for all times \(t \geq 0\). Find the value of \(\frac{d r}{d t}\) at \(\theta=\frac{\pi}{6}\).
\item[(a)]
\[
\begin{aligned}
\text { Area } & =\frac{9 \pi}{4}+\frac{1}{2} \int_{0}^{\pi / 2}(3-2 \sin (2 \theta))^{2} d \theta \\
& =9.708(\text { or } 9.707)
\end{aligned}
\]
\item[(b)]
\[
\begin{gathered}
x=(3-2 \sin (2 \theta)) \cos \theta \\
\left.\frac{d x}{d \theta}\right|_{\theta=\pi / 6}=-2.366
\end{gathered}
\]
\item[(c)] The distance between the two curves is
\[
\begin{aligned}
& D=3-(3-2 \sin (2 \theta))=2 \sin (2 \theta) . \\
& \left.\frac{d D}{d \theta}\right|_{\theta=\pi / 3}=-2
\end{aligned}
\]
\item[(d)]
\[
\begin{aligned}
& \frac{d r}{d t}=\frac{d r}{d \theta} \cdot \frac{d \theta}{d t}=\frac{d r}{d \theta} \cdot 3 \\
& \left.\frac{d r}{d t}\right|_{\theta=\pi / 6}=(-2)(3)=-6
\end{aligned}
\]
\item[] \(3:\left\{\begin{array}{l}1: \text { integrand } \\ 1: \text { limits } \\ 1: \text { answer }\end{array}\right.\)
\item[] \(2:\left\{\begin{array}{l}1: \text { expression for } x \\ 1: \text { answer }\end{array}\right.\)
\item[] \(2:\left\{\begin{array}{l}1: \text { expression for distance } \\ 1: \text { answer }\end{array}\right.\)
\item[] \(2:\left\{\begin{array}{l}1 \text { : chain rule with respect to } t \\ 1: \text { answer }\end{array}\right.\)
\end{itemize}
